about.mission_p1: The "Princess of Dubai" pageant is a landmark social event of world-class significance — a bridge between the cultures of East and West. It combines the aesthetics of high fashion, fidelity to tradition, and a charitable mission. It is not merely a beauty contest, but a celebration of femininity, family, and spiritual perfection, taking place in the jewel of the Middle East under the patronage of the UAE Government.
about.mission_p2: In 2026, the pageant will reach new heights of grandeur, gathering the global elite within the walls of luxurious palaces and hotels. Each participant becomes part of a legend, and the winner attains the status of a Goodwill Ambassador.
about.value1_text: Each participant represents her country through meaningful stories, traditions, and heritage of the Emirates.
about.value2_text: Knowledge, refined speech, and the ability to articulate ideas on the international stage.
about.value3_text: Leadership that begins with respect for oneself, one's culture, and communities worldwide.
about.value4_text: Strengthening intercultural ties and humanitarian initiatives across nations.
about.value5_text: Beauty as the harmony of strength, gentleness, character, and spiritual perfection.
about.venue_title: Dubai — The International Capital of Beauty, Style, and Boundless Opportunities
about.venue_p1: All events are held on the premises of five-star hotels and luxurious palace complexes in Dubai. The city has established itself as a space for the convergence of diverse cultures, traditions, and aspirations — making it the natural home for a pageant built on international dialogue, elegance, and the modern feminine spirit.
about.venue_p2: The finale and all related events are executed in a unified stylistic concept, emphasizing the grandeur, luxury, and hospitality of Dubai.
about.criteria1_text: Harmonious, proportionate physique, impeccable grooming, and a sense of style commensurate with an international pageant.
about.criteria2_text: Proper speech, the ability to engage in social conversation, friendliness, and knowledge of international etiquette.
about.criteria3_text: The ability to win people over, inner light, magnetism, and the ability to be the center of attention.
about.criteria4_text: Possession of talent — vocals, choreography, painting, acting — and the ability to present it effectively on stage.
about.criteria5_text: Beauty of movement, the ability to carry oneself on stage, on the runway, and in high society.
about.criteria6_text: Alignment with the image of a successful woman who shares traditional family values and strives for harmonious development.
about.stage1_text: Online and offline casting opens worldwide, welcoming women aged 21–45 from every corner of the globe.
about.stage2_text: The ceremonial start of the project with organizers, honoured guests, stars, and all finalists in one of Dubai's luxurious hotels.
about.stage3_text: Trainings, rehearsals, reality show filming, SPA programs, cosmetology procedures, and master classes from celebrity mentors.
about.stage4_text: An exclusive community gathering of finalists, honoured guests, partners, sponsors, and investors.
about.stage5_text: A modern interpretation of the institute of noble maidens — participants learn the science of being a woman, etiquette, and cultural traditions.
about.stage6_text: Exclusive presentation of collections by leading international designers, featuring the finalists as models.
about.stage7_text: A private evening with an auction of exclusive lots from partners. All proceeds help children in need.
about.finale_text: A grand show featuring world-class stars. The culmination: the crowning of the Princess of Dubai under the slogan 'Where Elegance Meets Eternity.'
about.participants_p1: Participating in "Princess of Dubai" is an opportunity to touch the world of high fashion and elite society. Open to women aged 21 to 45 who have passed the official casting, as well as winners of national and regional beauty contests.
about.fee_description: Covers accommodation, trainings, SPA, photo shoots, transfers, and registration.
about.benefit1: Accommodation in a five-star hotel throughout the preparatory and event period
about.benefit2: Participation in all preparatory events and master classes from star mentors
about.benefit3: Cosmetology and SPA procedures from premium partners
about.benefit4: Professional photo shoots with international photographers
about.benefit5: Image styling by world-renowned stylists, makeup artists, and designers
about.benefit6: Acting, choreography, vocals, and catwalk training
about.benefit7: Publication in an international glossy magazine
about.benefit8: Invitation to the 'Princess of Abu Dhabi' pageant with special status
about.benefit9: Potential contract with a modeling agency
about.partners_p1: Partners of "Princess of Dubai" are companies that share the values of elegance, family, and charity. The pageant offers brand recognition in an international context, integration into the competition program, access to a wide and affluent audience, and a contribution to international cultural initiatives.

about.contact_p1: "Princess of Dubai" is more than just a pageant. It is a story of luxury, beauty, and talent unfolding before your eyes. The number of participants and partnership packages is strictly limited.
